text.en:
Probate and Administration Act
(Chapter 251, Section 29(3))
Appointment of Registrar of Supreme Court to Exercise
Jurisdiction in Summonses-in-chambers
N 1
G.N. No. S 1010/1951
REVISED EDITION 2001
(31st January 2001)
[13th April 1951]
The Registrar of the Supreme Court, Singapore, has been appointed to exercise jurisdiction in Summonses-in-Chambers in which application is made that the matter of sureties be increased or decreased or that the sureties be dispensed with or that the amount of any administration bond in an administration matter be reduced.
